response.sql: SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Members with NULL link_to_major are excluded, and the denominator is the total members with a major (computed over all major groups before the top-10 limit), not just the top 10 shown.
Ties in fraction are broken arbitrarily since the request gives no tiebreaker.
